name: privacy
title: Privacy mode
description: Keeps identifying words out of the built site (build fails if they appear), and optionally blocks search indexing and third-party font requests.

forbid.description: Words or phrases that must not appear anywhere in the built site (case-insensitive), e.g. a course code or a school name.

forbidFile.description: Optional path (relative to the site) of a text file with one forbidden term per line, or a list of such paths (e.g. a sibling site's list too); keep them out of version control if the terms themselves are sensitive.

wholeWords.description: Match forbid terms only as whole words (so a short code does not match inside a longer word).

forbidPatterns.description: Regular expressions (Python syntax, case-insensitive) that must not match anywhere, for terms a plain list cannot express, e.g. "\\bab ?12\\b".

forbidPersonal.description: Also forbid home-folder paths (/Users/…, /home/…, C:\\Users\\…) and e-mail addresses.

scanSources.description: Also scan content/, custom/ and site packages/ sources, not just the output.

failBuild.description: Stop the build when a forbidden term is found (otherwise only `check` reports it).

localFonts.description: Drop third-party font stylesheets so the site makes no external requests (falls back to system fonts unless the site ships its own).
